commonDirection: Use the Shuttered Ward family plate only as the authoritative family-style and material reference: boiled dirty linen, lamp black, candle tallow, rain-dark leather and iron, solicitous ritual posture, restrained cold dread. Produce an original canonical form, not a copy of the plate subject. Highly polished stylized 3D dark-fantasy MMORPG production concept render, mature restrained anatomy and material density, single full-body subject in three-quarter view, all extremities visible, centered with generous silhouette clearance. assets.masterPrompt: A folded hospital sheet walks on humanlike hands tucked into its four corners; no torso or head exists inside, because the empty folded textile is the creature. It moves only in exact bed-length increments. Show four load-bearing corner hands and one corner ready to snap shut around an absent sleeper. The final orderly continued rounds after ward bells were sealed; it remakes empty beds and removes evidence that anyone left. Key cue: a pale rectangle measuring forward; counterplay: cut a load-bearing corner.
assets.revisionDirection: Make exactly four complete, separately visible load-bearing hands—one beneath each sheet corner—with no fifth hand and no occluded extremity.

assets.masterPrompt: An entirely hollow caregiver apron and suspended empty sleeves, with no head above it and no body within. A single candle burns downward inside the hollow apron, its flame bending toward an unseen warm target; no ordinary face, skull, or anatomy. It glides according to leaning lamp smoke. The caregiver promised no patient would die cold; it measures room warmth and apportions it to vacant beds. Keep the downward candle the unmistakable silhouette cue.

A tall wheeled privacy-screen frame draped in stained boiled-linen ward curtain, with far too many anatomically restrained human ears sewn along the curtain at different listening angles. No human body, face, or hidden person. The frame rolls only while hearing speech behind an obstruction; one embroidered ear turns sharply outward as its cue. Ward curtains heard confessions and refused burning; this form records symptoms absent patients never disclosed.

An empty long physician coat and vacant collar whose arms enter the sleeves from the cuffs and bend inward toward the empty coat, reversing normal anatomy. No conventional body, head, face, plague-doctor mask, or person inside. It walks backward through examination marks while a restrained red examination cord closes around architecture. A physician decided the building was the patient; it diagnoses architecture and amputates rooms deemed contagious.

cutoutDirection: After the master receives independent acceptance, create a cutout by editing that exact master. Preserve canvas dimensions, pose, design, materials, lighting, scale, placement and silhouette. Remove only the background. Output a real RGBA PNG with alpha 0 outside the subject and at all four corners; do not depict checkerboard, ground, shadow, backdrop, text, logo or watermark.
